title: Atomic Energy Commission contract for Puharich

tellings.quote: >> '63, '64. >> Yeah. >> That's when he gets the contract from Atomic Energy Energy Commission.

plain: In 1963 or 1964 a scientist named Puharich, whom the episode calls a CIA scientist who contacted an alien council, got a contract from the Atomic Energy Commission, the US government agency then in charge of nuclear research. An unnamed researcher who is a guest on Jesse Michels's show gives the dates in conversation with the host, without naming a source.
